## Hello, and welcome!
:::

Use two columns, one side chart and text - 

::::{.text-center}
I'm Gutama Girja Urago, a data scientist and research analyst with a passion for turning complex data into clear insights. I specialize in using R, Quarto, and related open-source tools to build reproducible, insightful, and locally relevant data products—especially in the context of development research and survey data analysis.

My work spans from developing custom R packages and dashboards to automating data workflows and building statistical tools. This site is my digital workspace, where I document what I build, reflect on what I learn, and share practical tools and ideas with the broader data community. Whether you're a fellow R user, a researcher, or someone working in development data, I hope you find something here that’s useful and inspiring.
::::
